about_the_game:
The trial version only includes numbers "0"-"21" and 17 types of treasure items.

————————————————————————————————————

This is a game that combines survivor, pigeon, search and play, treasure hunting, and mathematics.

You are a wizard from another world, using mathematics to create your own magic, entering different spaces, facing a constant stream of enemies, plundering various treasures to fill your treasure trove. Of course, you have to live to take away these spoils.

Your challenge

You will jump into another space to welcome a constant stream of enemies, who will gradually become stronger over time. However, you can also gain experience points and level up by defeating enemies, and during leveling up, you can gain different ability enhancements.

Your abilities

Each number is your magic, with different attack or auxiliary abilities. You will use basic arithmetic to combine your desired magic combinations.

Your goal

The other world is filled with monsters and treasures everywhere. You just need to mercilessly search for them and evacuate from the portal alive.

Your assistant

You have several assistants who can help you, and they are always available in the lobby to respond to your requests, making your adventure easier.
